integrity: Finite-state theorem proved analytically by zero-quality absorption and matrix-period arguments; numerical checker is corroborative, not an infinite-state certificate.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite irreducible contact matrix and strictly positive platform/social sensitivities; nonempty reference source has independent channel-user Bernoulli updates.
Unspecified empirical validity; first-order rare-quality limit is not uniform in network size.
Changing the all-empty platform share convention may change the conclusion.
Scientific priority is assessed against accessible literature; no independent historical audit.
title: A graph-period dichotomy for rare-quality monopoly selection in stochastic popularity networks
